snippet.title: Pixel art top down extraction Shooter game [No Such Place] has launched its DEMO
snippet.description:
*Disclaimer: The broadcast anchor and voice-over was generated using AI tools. All subsequent gameplay footage is 100% authentically recorded and contains zero AI-generated elements.
────────────────────────────────
URC agents,

The Dimensional Fragment Exploration Mission is now back online. Head to the link in the pinned comment to download the Demo and begin your expedition: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3299050/_/

In this Demo, you'll be able to experience the early stages of the game and team up with up to 4 players in co-op multiplayer.

If you previously participated in the Playtest and still have your save data, you can transfer your Playtest save to the Demo version.

In addition, part of your Demo progress—including your inventory and character data—will carry over to the full release version of the game.

Mission progress will be reset. Please note that save files from very early test versions may cause unexpected issues or bugs, so we recommend starting a fresh save for the best experience.
────────────────────────────────
If this is your first time hearing about the game, allow me to give a brief introduction:

No Such Place is a top-down extraction shooter developed by the Crit Team at ChillyRoom. As a field agent of the U.R.C., a supernatural anomaly investigation organization, you will be dispatched into shattered dimensional fragments to conduct reconnaissance missions.

Survive in environments filled with unknown threats, gather valuable resources and clues, and locate an extraction point before time runs out to make your way back to safety. Through the information and artifacts you recover, you'll gradually uncover truths that humanity has long forgotten — and bring them back into light.
────────────────────────────────
We will continue expanding the game with new content and features, so stay tuned for future updates and reveals.

If this video has caught your interest, or if you'd like to connect with other players after trying the Demo, you're welcome to join our Discord: and meet fellow U.R.C. agents.
────────────────────────────────
Finally, we wish you great loot, satisfying firefights, and smooth extractions.

And one last thing—making long-form videos takes a lot of work. If you enjoyed this video, don't forget to like, comment, subscribe, and follow the project. 
#extractionShooter #shootergames #steam #indiegame  #pixelart  #playtest  #gunsmith #unityengine #Chillyroom
